mapper.select: SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pc.name_cn, '') as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pc.name_cn, '') as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pc.name_cn, '') as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND (p.name_cn LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.name_en LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.description_cn LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.description_en LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pc.name_cn, '') as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND (p.name_cn LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.name_en LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.description_cn LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.description_en LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC
SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pc.name_cn, '') as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pc.name_cn, '') as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name_cn, name_en, description_cn, description_en, main_image, images, price, specifications, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{nameCn}, #{nameEn}, #{descriptionCn}, #{descriptionEn}, #{mainImage}, #{images}, #{price}, #{specifications}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
